title: Choni HaKatan
author: Aharon Hyman

paragraphs: He is mentioned in Tosefta Rosh Hashanah, end of chapter 2, where Beit Hillel said to Beit Shammai: “Was it not in the presence of all of you, the elders of Beit Shammai, that Choni HaKatan went down [before the ark] and said…,” etc.[^1]

notes.text: The whole consulted Mechon Mamre Tosefta Rosh Hashanah chapter 2 paragraph has Beit Hillel address Beit Shammai and recall Choni HaKatan going down and speaking before the elders. The supplied question, its direction, the bracketed explanation “[before the ark]” and the abbreviation “etc.” are retained. The continuation’s prayers and dispute are not added to the notice.
